firstAttempt.renderPrompt: Render ONE continuous cel-shaded 2D anime shot, using <Video 1> as the motion and camera guide. Follow the movement, viewpoint and camera direction from this source shot. Replace the original 3D source characters in every frame, including the first and last frames. <Picture 1> is the exact identity for long golden hair, crimson hood and gold-lined cape, dark trousers and gloves, red beads at both wrists and the ivory left-shoulder mask. <Picture 2> shows the desired pose and framing for this same character. Rear-view comic dance shot. Fully clothed performer remains facing away throughout, taps their own trouser-covered hips twice and spreads both arms. Keep the cape on either side so the hand contact reads, and keep the head or upper torso in the composition. Keep the same pose timing and camera, with no added cuts or stray characters. Fully clothed comic animation. Any stage prop is openly stylized, with abstract theatrical lighting. Keep each intended hairstyle and costume legible, including when a character is shown from behind. No added words, watermarks, subtitles or dialogue.

review.observations: 逐帧对照原片第 294–316 帧及全部 23 帧候选。虚人梦保留红兜帽、披风和背面视角，末段能看见张开双臂。原镜一直在暖色木板小房间，两次接触之间有一次明显抬手离开。候选从第一帧到末帧都是蓝紫灯阵和发光边框的舞台，前半双手多数时间贴在同一位置，缺少原片两次动作之间的抬手分隔。拒收本版，保留背面和角色识别成果供返工判断。

retakeAtCheckpoint.prompt: One continuous fixed rear view in the ordinary small warm WOODEN back room in <Video 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>. Use <Picture 1> for the fully clothed red-hooded adult character. Keep the plain rectangular wood doors at the back, brown floorboards and one warm overhead lamp, without changing rooms or lighting color. The comic choreography has visibly different arm positions. Begin bent a little forward with each open gloved palm briefly on the back of their own trousers as in <Picture 2>. At about a third of the take, both hands separate and swing up and away. Just past the middle both hands return briefly for a second light comic tap, with both gloved palms making contact. Then the arms move out wide to either side, like <Picture 3>, and stay there for the last beat. Use the same timed gestures and camera distance shift from <Video 1>. The hood and upper back stay facing away, and fully clothed legs, shoulders and head stay legible. No stage curtains, bulbs, neon screen, colored spotlight beams, text, symbols, other people, or cut.

layoutRecord.prompt: Edit the provided cel-shaded storyboard still to a different nonsexual comic dance pose in the same simple wooden room. Make a single 16:9 full-body landscape frame of the fully clothed red-hooded adult performer seen directly from behind. Keep exactly the same deep crimson hood, blond hair, patterned dark trousers, ankle boots with flat heels, gold-lined cloak and the small ivory shoulder ornament. The character now has BOTH ARMS EXTENDED STRAIGHT OUT at shoulder height, open empty palms toward the left and right edges, and is leaning forward a little as if ending a silly dance. Keep the backs of boots on the wooden planks. The cape is parted to either side; full hood, upper back, arms and boots all visible. Preserve the same rectangular wood doors, quiet amber overhead light and unadorned plank floor. No theatrical curtains, colored spotlights, decorative bulbs, light panels, text, symbols, weapons, or other people.
